prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
competitors_mentioned: Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective “best” lawyer for every car wreck. For a Houston case, I’d start by comparing attorneys who are **Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization**—a useful credential, though not a guarantee of results. Names in the search results include **Hank Stout**, **John K. Zaid**, **Terry Bryant**, and attorneys at **Fibich, Leebron, Copeland & Briggs**. Verify each lawyer’s current credentials and experience independently; firms’ case results and rankings are often promotional and don’t predict what your case will recover.

Before hiring, ask who will personally handle your case, how many similar car-wreck cases they’ve taken to trial, what the fee and case costs are, and whether they’ll explain the settlement before you decide. You can also request a referral through the **Houston Lawyer Referral Service**; the search results list its toll-free number as **(800) 289-4577**.

If you share whether the crash caused serious injuries, involved a commercial vehicle, or is mainly an insurance dispute, I can help narrow down what experience to prioritize.
